description: Defines the HttpStreamFactory class and related nested classes for managing HTTP stream requests, including different job types and connection strategies within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing HTTP streams, supporting different protocols and preconnection strategies.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactory::Job
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for establishing an HTTP connection.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactory::JobController
classes.description: Manages a set of jobs for a particular request or preconnect.

methods.name: RequestStream
methods.description: Initiates a request for an HTTP stream.

methods.name: RequestWebSocketHandshakeStream
methods.description: Initiates a WebSocket handshake stream request.

methods.name: PreconnectStreams
methods.description: Pre-establishes a number of streams for future use.
